title: Let the developer choose when to trigger the search.
body:
## Current behavior

Every time a user changes a filter or change an input, this triggers a new search which will then trigger a refresh of the UI with the new results.

## Problem

This is perfect for desktop environment where there is a lot of space to display both the results and the refinements.

On mobile, space is scarce and we often need to have the refinements and the results on separate screens, and this leads to unnecessary calls to the search API because the results are not visible.

## Possible fix

Let the dev choose when to refresh (disable the auto search + provide a method on instantsearch to trigger the search). But then the filters values are not updated, which might leave the user with the "no results and I don't know why" UX...

Other ideas?
